notes.title: Patch 1.14 (+ Incoming Steam Trading Cards!)
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope everyone is doing fine.

We've just updated our game with another set of small fixes, so we hope you will enjoy them on your playthroughs! We've also included the addition of Steam Trading Cards! They should be available quite soon, so be ready for those notifications :)

[b]Patch Notes 1.14[/b]
[list]
[*]small bug fixes
[*]a couple of Quality of Life fixes
[/list]

Thank you for sticking with us and we're extremely happy to see that you guys are enjoying the game! If you notice a bug, or if you have any suggestions - let us know by leaving a comment here or by creating a thread on Steam!

Until next time!

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We hope everyone is staying safe during this pandemic. We've got a new patch that should be live in a couple of minutes, here's what it contains:

[b]Patch Notes 1.13[/b]
[list]
[*]GHO window fixes: added the influence display which shows the level of contribution and its impact on countries' influence
[*]added automatic value updates
[*]visual fixes
[*]improved balance
[*]small fixes
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us and we hope you will continue to enjoy our game! Stay safe out there!

notes.title: Patch 1.12

notes.title: Patch 1.11
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A small Wednesday patch is incoming, fixing these things right here:

notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

notes.title: Patch 1.09
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Another quick patch coming in to fix some pesky bugs, check it out:

[b]Patch Notes 1.09[/b]
[list]
[*]fixed anarchy not ending
[*]fixed anarchy spawning in the same place
[*]minor bug fixes with anarchy save
[*]fixed anarchy model not disappearing after spawning in the same place

There you have it! If you notice anything wrong please let us know in the comments or by creating a Steam thread in the discussions. Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 1.05
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

Tuesday has brought us another patch for COVID: The Outbreak, so we hope this one will fix some of the issues you have encountered during your playthroughs:

[b]Patch Notes 1.05[/b]
[list]
[*]keys [ and ] will now enable you to change the game's speed
[*]pressing r,f,v will center the view on a particular unit
[*]improved project status visibility:
blue - available
green - implemented
blue-green blinking - in progress
red - locked
[*]fixed bug where resources were loaded on the 5th day
[*]small hotkeys fixes
[*]fixed some small minor bugs (including visual ones)
[*]fixed bug where if the event text was long and had a scroll, the scroll wasn't on the very top
[*]fixed the missing Polish subtitle in the intro video
[*]fixed bug where the scroll didn't work in the save window
[*]fixed some resolution bugs during credits
[*]pressing the C key will now also change the map mode on the right side to the Panic mode
[*]changing the map mode via a hot key will now avoid turning on/off units
[/list]

There you go! Another day makes our game that much better! Thank you for your continuous support!

Until next time guys!

notes.title: Patch 1.04 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We're kicking off the week with a brand new patch 1.04 which adds some interesting things, some of which you have requested, so let's dive in and check them out:

[b]Patch Notes 1.04[/b][list]
[*]fixed a crash bug when exiting the game
[*]new hotkeys added:
1. GHO window
2. Country Info
3. Buildings
4. Projects
5. Decrees
6. Vaccine
7. Simulation
Q/E - Zoom in/out
R - select Security Unit (multiple pressing of the key will switch between units if we have more of them)
F - select Specialist Unit
V - select Diplomat Unit
C - Panic Map
Z,X - change map mode
WASD - camera control
[*] improved optimization
[*] fixed a bug with the Headquarters being built once more
[*] some balance changes
[*] Vaccine Research: now slots will swap objects when you put one into the other
[*] some small fixes
[/list]

That's it! Let us know how are these changes holding up in the game and if you happen to come across a bug let us know in the comments or create a new thread in the Steam discussions.

Thank you and until next time!

notes.title: Patch 1.03

a small update is now live, here's what's in it:

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]

That's it for this little update, thank you for your support! If you do happen to encounter an issue please let us know in the comments or create a thread in the Steam discussions and we will try to solve it together :)

notes.title: COVID: The Outbreak Now Live! (+1.02 Patch Notes)
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey Everyone![/h1]

Our real-time strategy game is now live and we would like to thank you for your support in these very first few launch hours! Enjoy the game to the fullest!

Speaking of live, we've also done some patching up during these last hours - by all means check out what has been accomplished:

[b]1.02 Patch Notes [/b][list]
[*]fixed missing Chinese letters
[*]fixed certain actions
[*]some balance changes
[*]small fixes in vaccine evaluation
[*]small UI fixes
[*]available projects and decrees will now be better indicated
[*]fixed new game issues
[*]various localization fixes
[*]various visual fixes
[*]other small fixes
[/list]

That's about it for this little update. Enjoy the game and let us know your thoughts in the comments and in the Steam discussions. We read all of them so be sure to leave a message :)

Until next time and stay safe out there!
